annotations.title: Find Lichess clubs at a rating

description: Up to ten Lichess clubs (teams) where the given rating sits in the middle half of the members' blitz or rapid ratings, largest first, with member counts, medians, how many members were active in the last month, and a Start link for each. Use when a player wants a club at their level.

open_to_join.description: True for clubs anyone can join without approval. Default false.

rating.description: A Lichess blitz or rapid rating.
